purpose: Teach: 財閥/縦横/色濃く/ドラッカー/声楽/命がけ/評し/降水

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、本気で、絶対、財閥、絶対、系列病院、絶対、医療界、絶対、影響、絶対、ありますね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Ren, the impact that zaibatsu-affiliated hospitals have on the medical world is really profound. I'm genuinely grateful.
lines.style: Measured, direct. Warm recognition without overselling. Even cadence, eyes steady. The clarity of someone who has thought this through many times.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療チームが、本気で、絶対、縦横、絶対、無尽、絶対、ご活躍、絶対、されているそうですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The medical team really does work tirelessly across every dimension, doesn't it, Doctor? I'm truly grateful for that.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly uncertain but genuine. Leans into the question like he's checking his own understanding. Softer attack, steady middle ground.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。地域の医療伝統、本気for、絶対、色濃く、絶対、残る、絶対、病院、絶対、貴重ですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. A hospital that preserves the region's medical traditions so deeply is invaluable. That work matters.
lines.style: Assured but not clinical. Each phrase lands with quiet conviction. Slight pause before 'invaluable' — the weight of meaning. Not rushing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 病院経営に、本気で、絶対、ドラッカー、絶対、の考え、絶対、取り入れて、絶対、いらっしゃるんですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So you've actually incorporated Drucker's thinking into how you manage the hospital? That's remarkable, Doctor.
lines.style: Genuinely interested, a little surprised. Leans forward slightly. The dawning recognition of a system thought through. Warm but not effusive.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者さんの、本気で、絶対、声楽、絶対、療法、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've been integrating music and voice therapy into our patient care — it helps the whole team move forward together.
lines.style: Clear, methodical. Pride in the approach without arrogance. Slower on 'voice therapy' — letting the concept breathe. Settled confidence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 救急医療、本気で、絶対、命がけ、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、本当にありがたいですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Emergency medicine is truly demanding work — the medical team carries such weight. I'm really grateful for what they do.
lines.style: Quiet weight underneath. Recognition of sacrifice. Slower pace, especially on 'weight.' Trailing sincerity at the end, not performed.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。新治療を、本気で、絶対、専門家、絶対、評し、絶対、た、絶対、報告、絶対、参考にしております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We study the latest evaluations from specialists and use those reports to guide our new approaches.
lines.style: Methodical, assured. Clinical precision softened by personal care. Even rhythm. The voice of someone translating complex ideas into human practice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 豪雨の、本気で、絶対、降水、絶対、で、絶対、感染症、絶対、増えるそうですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Heavy rainfall does increase infection rates in the region, I've noticed. It's something we're watching carefully.
lines.style: Observational, steady. No alarm, but attentive — the tone of someone tracking patterns. Slight trailing-off on the final phrase, like turning to look out a window.
